name: Knucklespike Vow
description: Rest the weight back with the claws folded at the chest like a hawk with wings drawn in.

name: Triumphant Clawrake
description: Open the exchange with a single paired rake that scores the forearm and tests the opponent's reply.

name: Squall Clawbase
description: Hop forward on the toes with the arms half spread and land inside the opponent's first swing.

name: Millstone Hookclaw
description: Hook the lead forearm as a hawk grips a perch and pull it down across the opponent's own guard.

name: Heroic Scour
description: Slash round the rim of the opponent's guard in a curve that enters from the side.

name: Venomflay
description: Brush the claw across the wrist and turn it sharply so the opponent's grip loosens.

name: Radiance Backplate
description: Stab shallow with all four tines at once into the muscle of the shoulder and withdraw.

name: Haemaltalon
description: Fall onto the target with both claws and rend down in a heavy arc that opens guard and body.

name: Flay Vow
description: Cling to the opponent with both claws and press steadily until his strength gives out.

name: Seasonraze
description: Spring from a crouch to the opponent's back in one flash and set the claws at his shoulders.

name: Haemal Palmstrap
description: Bring both claws down on one point as a single stoop so the school's pair lands as one blow.

name: Bedrock Talon
description: Hold one claw high and one low along two lines like the two banks of a river.

name: Vigorshred
description: Pull the claw along the opponent's forearm so the edge scores it end to end.

name: Squall Fingerblade
description: Step left then right in a flowing line and keep both claws facing the opponent.

name: Masterful Clawtip
description: Hook the arm and walk it along the bank of the guard until the elbow is trapped.

name: Intrepid Shred
description: Slash with the second claw along the track the first has just left open.

name: Talontroth
description: Turn a blow at the river's bend and rake along the arm as it slides by.

name: Thunderclap Tinecurve
description: Cut along both tracks together down the length of the target and split its defense.

name: Shredvow
description: Draw a steady current of qi into the hooks to bind the arms for as long as it flows.

name: Prismnail
description: Take the blow in the crossed claws and return it down the second track at its sender.

name: Noble Quenched Wristband
description: Run both tracks together into a single wide rake that falls across the whole front of the opponent.

name: Prism Knucklespike
description: Stand with the arms extended a little and both claws turned to cover the reach on either side.

name: Talonbanner
description: Draw one claw from beside the ear down through the target in a plain downward line.

name: Spectral Shred
description: Slide to the edge of the opponent's reach and hold there with the claws forward.

name: Pealnail
description: Check the opponent's striking wrist with the near claw and push it off the line.

name: Subjugating Rip
description: Reach out with the hooked claw to lift the opponent's guarding arm away from the chest.

name: Shredbanner
description: Throw two long slashes from full reach one after the other before the opponent can close.

name: Entropy Raze
description: Open the guard with a sharp upward flick of the hooked claw under the elbow.

name: Steel Clawbase
description: Thrust the tines between two plates of armor at the full extent of the reach.

name: Imperial Hookclaw
description: Rend with both claws at the end of the reach where the stroke carries the most force.

name: Gloomraze
description: Pin the opponent at the end of the reach with both hooks until he stops struggling.

name: Bloom Talon
description: Draw qi into the extended arm so the next rake lands with the force of the whole reach.

name: Thunderclap Palmstrap
description: Send both claws out to the full reach together and bring them back through the target as one pair.

name: Enshrined Wristband
description: Stand ready with the claws crossed before the chest as at the start of a crossing.

name: Inferno Raze
description: Rake along the opponent's flank as you pass him on the way to the far side.

name: Surging Tinecurve
description: Step forward onto a firm footing as at a ford and keep the claws steady over the front foot.

name: Scour Covenant
description: Hook the opponent in the middle of the exchange and pull him off the line he has chosen.

name: Inferno Clawtip
description: Alternate slashes from the left claw and the right in steady beats as two courts speak in turn.

name: Pealtalon
description: Wrench the hooked arm against the current of the opponent's motion so it breaks off.

name: Vaunted Flay
description: Rend through the target in a long step that carries the claws from one side of him to the other.

name: Nailseal
description: Hold the opponent between the two claws with firm pressure until the crossing is won.

name: Wraithlike Rip
description: Vanish from one bank of the exchange and appear on the other with a rake already falling.

name: Symphonic Fingerblade Crown
description: Carry the guard the hook and the rake across the opponent in order so the two courts finish the crossing together.

name: Prism Clawbase
description: Sit into the stance and spread the qi field out over both claws so the front is guarded at a distance.

name: Quenched Clawrake
description: Rake along the field's two tracks at once so the strokes cross inside the target's guard.

name: Squall Palmstrap
description: Glide along the guarding track while the field sweeps ahead and clears the opponent's reach.

name: Authoritative Backplate
description: Hook the arm with the tines and a hooked tongue of field and pull it off the line.

name: Haemal Hookclaw
description: Slash twice through the field so the first cut stuns and the second finds the stunned place.

name: Venom Raze
description: Wrench the opponent's guard open from the guarding track and cut in along the striking track.

name: Sovereign Flay
description: Draw the field down to a needle at the tines and thrust it into the gap behind a plate.

name: Vigorraze
description: Sunder the target with both tracks of the field folded together into one heavy stroke.

name: Volition Backplate
description: Lock both tracks of the field on the opponent's limbs and hold him fast with steady pressure.

name: Destiny Knucklespike
description: Rake along both tracks so that the qi passes armor and tears at the body beneath it.

name: Splendid Talon
description: Strike along one track while the other holds the field as a guard so the school's claw cuts and shields together.

name: Steel Clawtip
description: Settle the stance with the formed Core low and steady and the claws held forward over it.

name: Steel Tinecurve
description: Rake with both azure talons in one clean drop that tears along two adjacent lines.

name: Vigor Wristband
description: Pivot from the Core outward so the whole body turns with the feet and the claws never lag.

name: Deluge Wristband
description: Brush the opponent's strike away with the flat of the talon backed by a steady pulse from the Core.

name: Ruling Clawrake
description: Hook the elbow and lift with the strength that rises from the Core so the guard goes up.

name: Shred Crown
description: Rake twice with the talons so the second pass opens the line the first has scored.

name: Entropy Palmstrap
description: Wrench the hooked wrist with a surge from the Core that sends the grip flying open.

name: Talonverdict
description: Stab with the talon point fed by a thread of qi and drive it deep between the ribs.

name: Magnificent Hookclaw
description: Rend the target with the whole power of the Core delivered through both talons.

name: Crushing Clawrake
description: Bind the opponent with both talons while the Core feeds the grip and keeps the hooks set.

name: Pulsarpawl
description: Flash from one place to another driven by the Core and rake in passing with both talons.

name: Famed Steel Fingerblade
description: Drive both talons from the formed Core in one stroke so the school's pair is released at once.

name: Sacrosanct Talon
description: Take the ground stance of the plateau with the claws forward and the knees slightly bent.

name: Magnificent Raze
description: Draw the claw through the target in a stroke that is quiet in the start and hard in the end.

name: Soundless Shred
description: Skim across the ground in a low light step as the wind skims a bare field.

name: Vising Knucklespike
description: Hook the sleeve and haul it as an oath is hauled to the chest and held there.

name: Squallscour
description: Slash across the front in a long flat line like wind crossing the plateau.

name: Entropy Scour
description: Twist the hooked wrist in a sudden gale of motion that unclenches the opponent's grip.

name: Paramount Backplate
description: Sunder the opponent's guard with a rake that carries the strength of the plateau wind.

name: Gloom Tinecurve
description: Pin the opponent with both claws on his arms and keep the pin as a sworn oath is kept.

name: Radiance Clawtip
description: Catch a heavy blow on the claws and send its force back as the wind returns a thrown stone.

name: Peerless Bedrock Flay
description: Deliver the sworn stroke of the plateau school in one motion from the guard through the target.

name: Nailpledge
description: Seat the stance firmly and hold the claws up as if an oath rested on the guard.

name: Gallant Rip
description: Draw the claw down the opponent's chest with a pull like the first push of a gale.

name: Surging Clawtip
description: Step forward when the gust rises and hold the ground gained when it falls.

name: Parity Backplate
description: Sweep both claws across the front to cover the high and low lines in one broad motion.

name: Sigil Clawrake
description: Tug on the hooked sleeve in short firm pulls that never let the opponent settle.

name: Vigorscour
description: Slash once from each claw in a pair of quick strokes that follow like two gusts.

name: Ruling Rip
description: Wrench the hooked elbow or knee to break the stance and leave the opponent off balance.

name: Famed Clawbase
description: Thrust the tines in a narrow line through a gap in the armor like a gale through a crack.

name: Flaytriumph
description: Rend with the weight of the sworn oath and the whole gale behind the claws.

name: Commanding Shred
description: Bind and press the opponent down under the hooks while the gale pushes at his back.

name: Dauntless Fingerblade
description: Rake with a gale that passes through armor and cuts the body behind it.

name: Steel Hookclaw
description: Bind the stroke to the oath at its start and let the gale carry it through to the end.

name: Adamant Talon
description: Hold the claws steady at the chest while the gale pulls at the arms and cannot move them.

name: Steelscour
description: Rake in the direction the wind blows so the stroke gains the push of the gust behind it.

name: Bedrock Wristband
description: Brace on the rear foot against a gust and step on the lull that follows.

name: Scourseal
description: Pull on the hooked arm with a steady strength that does not slacken in the gusts.

name: Thunderclap Rip
description: Throw three short slashes between gusts so each stroke lands in the lull.

name: Talonseal
description: Press down on the hooked wrist with the whole weight of the shoulder until the strike fails.

name: Gallant Clawbase
description: Thrust the tines so narrow that the wind parts around them and the points reach the ribs.

name: Vaunted Scour
description: Rend downward without a tremor in the arm and let the gale drive the claw home.

name: Gloom Scour
description: Pin the opponent's arm with one steady claw and keep it there against the pull of the gale.

name: Hospitable Fingerblade
description: Hold the gale steady in the arm and release it all at once into the next rake.

name: Sigil Knucklespike
description: Set the hooks and rake in the same breath so the school's steady hand cuts while the gale blows.

name: Steelnail
description: Hold the guard of the old rakers with the claws crossed low and the eyes on the opponent's chest.

name: Quenched Shred
description: Rake in the oldest line of the plateau school straight down from shoulder to hip.

name: Evanescent Tinecurve
description: Skim forward on the front of the foot keeping the weight light and the claws low.

name: Sigilscour
description: Drag the hooked arm in a long pull that keeps the opponent leaning onto the claws.

name: Bedrock Scour
description: Cross two slashes over the chest in the shape of a sworn mark and open the guard.

name: Despotic Flay
description: Pry the guard apart with the hooks and drive between the arms toward the throat.

name: Lordly Clawtip
description: Rend down the line of the old rakers so the whole front of the target is opened.

name: Raze Seal
description: Pin the opponent under the claws and keep him there until the oath of the stroke is satisfied.

name: Radiance Palmstrap
description: Flash from one side of the opponent to the other and score him at the edge of passing.

name: Triumphant Haemal Flay
description: Deliver the sworn rake of the plateau school in full from raised guard to the end of the stroke.

name: Pawlvow
description: Seat the stance in the gale and spread the field around the claws to blunt its push.

name: Thunderclap Knucklespike
description: Draw the claw through the target with the gale-driven field extending the cut past the tips.

name: Fingerblade Boon
description: Glide on the edge of the field with the gale at the back and the feet barely touching.

name: Squall Wristband
description: Spread the gale-borne field across the claw to turn a stroke aside before it lands.

name: Thrallflay
description: Cast a hook of the field and haul the opponent's arm toward the claw on the wind.

name: Exalted Tinecurve
description: Throw a spread of slashes through the field that arrive from the front and both sides.

name: Venompawl
description: Close the field on the wrist in a gale-driven wrench that strips the weapon away.

name: Exalted Clawrake
description: Draw the field to a needle point and thrust it through armor seams on the wind.

name: Inferno Clawbase
description: Sunder the target with a gale-fed field stroke that cuts a hand's breadth beyond the claws.

name: Gloom Talon
description: Press the field down on the opponent as a gale presses grass and hold him to the ground.

name: Lordly Raze
description: Hurl a storm of rakes through the field so fast that the opponent can only guard.

name: Illustrious Squall Backplate
description: Send the school's claw through the field in one stroke that the gale carries beyond the hand.

name: Steelpawl
description: Seat the stance on the bearing with the Core settled low and the claws forward.

name: Steelraze
description: Draw the claw along the bearing with the wind pressing at the shoulder.

name: Feather Knucklespike
description: Step from the Core on the wind so the feet follow the body without hurry.

name: Thralltalon
description: Hook the arm along the bearing with a pull that rises from the Core.

name: Quenched Clawbase
description: Slash in short strokes that all pass through the bearing and fall on the same place.

name: Shredtroth
description: Wrench the hooked wrist with an oath-bound surge from the Core that unlocks the opponent's grip.

name: Flay Banner
description: Thrust a needle of wind along the bearing and pierce the plate that stands on it.

name: Bedrock Palmstrap
description: Rend along the bearing with the Core and the wind driving both claws through together.

name: Volition Rip
description: Pin the opponent along the bearing and hold him there with the oath and the Core behind the grip.

name: Pawlpledge
description: Take the blow on the claws and return its full weight along the same bearing from the Core.

name: Quenched Clawtip
description: Release the claw along the sworn bearing from the Core in one stroke that the wind does not turn.
